tt_func.notes: Every generated TTIR snapshot has a public tt.func entry. Phase 7 importer skeleton should map this to the value-layer function/kernel boundary, not directly to vc4kernel.

tt_return.notes: All Phase 6 corpus kernels contain tt.return. Future reductions may introduce helper tt.func regions with additional returns.

tt_get_program_id_axis0.notes: Required elementwise candidates use axis 0. The matmul future corpus also observes axis 1; axis 1 remains staged for multidimensional grid planning.

tt_make_range_or_arange.notes: Triton tl.arange lowers to tt.make_range tensor forms. Phase 7 should recognize the vector<16> lane range pattern for B16 elementwise snapshots.

tt_splat.notes: Observed in pointer/base scalar expansion, scalar argument expansion, and constants broadcast to tensor lanes.

tt_load_tensor_of_pointers_mask_other_ze.notes: Required elementwise snapshots use masked tensor-of-pointers loads with other=0.0 or other=0. Softmax uses other=-inf and is staged.

tt_store_tensor_of_pointers_mask.notes: Required elementwise snapshots use masked tensor-of-pointers stores. Sparse/unknown store masks remain a later legality concern.

arith_addi_tensor.notes: Observed for offset math in all elementwise snapshots and i32 arithmetic in i32_add_select_b16.

arith_addf_tensor.notes: Required for f32 elementwise candidates vector_add_b16 and saxpy_select_b16. Not expected in the pure i32 candidate.

arith_cmpi_tensor.notes: Observed for mask construction, bounds checks, and i32 compare/select.

arith_cmpf_tensor.notes: Observed in saxpy_select_b16 for f32 threshold comparison. Not expected in vector_add_b16 or i32_add_select_b16.

tt_or_arith_where_select_pattern.notes: Triton tl.where lowered to arith.select in saxpy_select_b16 and i32_add_select_b16. Not expected in vector_add_b16.

future_tl_sum_reduce.notes: Observed in softmax_row and layer_norm_forward. Phase 7 must inventory but not lower reductions.

future_tl_exp_approx.notes: Observed in softmax_row. VC4 SFU lowering requires explicit approximate/target policy in a later math phase.

future_tl_dot.notes: Observed in matmul_dot. Must not be simplified away or lowered directly to vc4kernel in Phase 6 or 7.

future_block_pointer_forms.notes: Not observed in the current Phase 6 corpus, which uses explicit tensor-of-pointers arithmetic. Real block pointer forms remain a future profile target.

atomics.notes: Not observed in the Phase 6 corpus. Initial VC4 value/Triton importer should reject atomics deterministically.

cache_modifiers.value_surface_target: deterministic reject or ignored only with proof
cache_modifiers.notes: Not observed as distinct TTIR ops in the Phase 6 corpus. Any cache modifier attributes must be inventoried after parse and rejected unless a future VC4 memory policy proves semantics.

volatile.notes: Not observed in the Phase 6 corpus. Volatile memory semantics are outside the Phase 7 elementwise smoke scope.
